name: Field tote, waxed
summary: An open tote for the market, the library and everything in between. The same waxed cotton as the weekender, with an inside pocket that closes.
highlights: Carries a laptop up to 15 inches
Handles long enough for the shoulder

care.title: How do I clean it?
care.description: A damp cloth for the outside; turn it out and shake it for the inside. No washing machine.

care.title: Why only three left?
care.description: We make about nine bags a week between four people. The next batch of totes is due in three weeks.
